description: Convert Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) and Markdown (.md) files to paginated PDF documents on standard paper sizes (A4, A3, B5, …) with light/dark page themes and optional password protection.
cmd.convertToPdf.title: Convert Notebook/Markdown to PDF
cmd.convertToPdfWithPassword.title: Convert Notebook/Markdown to PDF (with Password)
cmd.convertToPdfHossam.title: Convert Notebook/Markdown to PDF (hossam)
cmd.convertToPdfHossamWithPassword.title: Convert Notebook/Markdown to PDF (hossam, with Password)
cmd.convertToPdfJussam.title: Convert Notebook/Markdown to PDF (jussam)
cmd.convertToPdfJussamWithPassword.title: Convert Notebook/Markdown to PDF (jussam, with Password)
config.title: Ipynb PDF Converter
config.pdfTheme.description: Overall page theme (paper, text, headings, tables, outputs), ported from nb_convert.py. Code cells always use 'codeTheme'. The 'leekh' chrome (emoji headings) applies only with 'default'.
config.pdfTheme.enum.1: Light: Markdown Reader light palette (nb_convert.py --theme light)
config.pdfTheme.enum.2: Dark: Markdown Reader dark palette (nb_convert.py --theme dark)
config.codeTheme.description: Syntax highlighting theme for source code cells. 'leekh' also restyles headings, tables, and outputs to match the A4 print layout when pdfTheme is 'default'.
config.codeTheme.enum.10: Leekh (vertical/A4 print style: emoji headings, colored sections, accented outputs)
config.pdfPageSize.description: Paper size of each PDF page. Content is laid out at 96 dpi (A4 portrait ≈ 794 × 1123 CSS px) and split across pages. Tablet entries are the device's logical screen size (CSS px), so a page fills the screen at 100%.
config.pdfPageSize.enum.7: Widescreen 16:9 slide (13.333 × 7.5 in, nb_convert.py horizontal mode; use with landscape orientation)
config.pdfPageMargin.description: Page margin on all four sides, in CSS pixels (48 px = 0.5 in, nb_convert.py's @page margin). The Markdown Reader page themes add the script's 30 px body margin inside it: on both sides of every page, and above/below the document on the first/last page.
config.outputDirectory.description: Where the PDF is written. Empty = next to the source file. A relative path is resolved from the source file's folder (e.g. "pdf"); absolute paths work too. Created if missing.
config.outputFileName.description: PDF file name without extension. Placeholders: {name} (source file name without extension), {date} (YYYY-MM-DD).
config.openAfterConvert.description: Open the PDF in the system viewer after a successful conversion.
config.headerText.description: Running header, drawn in the top margin band. Placeholders: {file}, {date}, {page}, {total}. Empty = no header.
config.footerText.description: Running footer, drawn in the bottom margin band. Placeholders: {file}, {date}, {page}, {total}. Empty = no footer.
config.headerFooterFontSize.description: Header/footer font size in CSS px (10 px ≈ 7.5 pt). Skipped when the page margin is smaller than twice this size.
config.pageBreakBefore.description: Headings that start a new page (default none: no breaks before headings). A heading that already sits at the very top of the document never forces a blank page. Pages also never cut through a text line, table row or image.
config.pageBreakBefore.enum.1: Before every h1 and h2 heading
config.pageBreakBefore.enum.2: Only before cells tagged in breakBeforeTags
config.breakBeforeTags.description: Notebook cells carrying any of these metadata tags start a new page (e.g. ["pagebreak"]).
config.hideCodeCells.description: Leave out the source of code cells; their outputs are still shown unless hideOutputs is on.
config.hideOutputs.description: Leave out all cell outputs (text, tables, images).
config.excludeCellTags.description: Notebook cells carrying any of these metadata tags are left out entirely (e.g. ["hide", "answer"]).
config.tableNowrap.description: Which table cells are kept on one line (white-space: nowrap). Applies to markdown tables and DataFrame outputs in every page theme.
config.tableNowrap.enum.0: First column only: snug, non-wrapping first column (nb_convert.py's layout)
config.tableNowrap.enum.1: All cells: no cell wraps (a wide table can run past the page edge)
config.showLineNumbers.enum.0: Follow the page theme: shown in 'default', hidden in 'light'/'dark' (nb_convert.py has none)
config.baseFontSize.description: Root font size in CSS px. Every text size in the document scales from it (16 px = nb_convert.py).
config.bodyFontFamily.description: CSS font-family for body text, e.g. "Pretendard", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif. Empty = the page theme's font (Helvetica Neue + Noto Sans CJK KR in light/dark).
config.codeFontFamily.description: CSS font-family for code cells, outputs and inline code, e.g. "JetBrains Mono", "D2Coding", monospace. Empty = the theme's font (Menlo in light/dark).
config.imageFormat.description: Encoding of each rendered page inside the PDF.
config.imageFormat.enum.1: Lossy; typically a quarter of the size or less, fine for text and tables
config.jpegQuality.description: JPEG quality (10-100) when imageFormat is jpeg.
config.deviceScaleFactor.description: Rendering scale factor for PDF resolution (1-5). Higher values produce sharper pages.
config.pdfPassword.description: Default password for 'Convert Notebook/Markdown to PDF (with Password)'. Leave empty to be prompted each time. The plain convert command never applies it. Stored in plain text in settings; encryption is 40-bit RC4 (jsPDF), which deters casual opening but is not strong protection.
config.pdfPermissions.description: What a reader who opens an encrypted PDF with the password may do. Default = nb_convert.py's rule: annotations and form filling only (no printing, copying or editing).
config.ownerPassword.description: Owner password of encrypted PDFs, which unlocks everything pdfPermissions denies. Empty = a random one per file, so nobody (including you) can lift the limits later.
config.coverPage.description: Add a cover page before the content.
config.coverSubtitle.description: Cover subtitle, shown under the title (e.g. "데이터 분석 부트캠프 58기" or "{date}"). Empty = none.
config.coverAuthor.description: Author line at the bottom of the cover. Empty = none.
config.watermarkImage.description: Image pinned to the top-right corner of the first page (nb_convert.py's --ssam mark). A path relative to the source file, an absolute path or an http(s) URL. Empty = none.
config.allowRemoteImages.description: Fetch http(s) images referenced by the document (15 s timeout each). Off = they are left out and listed in the output channel.
config.renderTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the webview may take to render and capture the document before the conversion fails. Raise it for very long notebooks.
config.teacherMode.description: Adds the hossam / jussam conversion commands (each with and without password) to the context menus and palette. Those modes draw the instructor mark (https://data.hossam.kr/itwill-ho.png or itwill-ju.png, 100 px wide) at the top right of every page in place of headerText, as nb_convert.py's --ssam did.
config.pdfPageSize.enum.11: iPad / iPad Air 11" (2360 × 1640 px panel; same size)
config.pdfPageSize.enum.13: Galaxy Tab S11 11" (2560 × 1600 px panel; S12 11" expected to match)
config.pdfPageSize.enum.14: Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra / S12 Ultra 14.6" (2960 × 1848 px panel; same size)
